name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 1999 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 1999 record supports: the seventeen CERT/CC advisories CA-1999-01 to CA-1999-17 (the trojaned TCP Wrappers and util-linux sources, Melissa, ExploreZip, the FTP, statd, cmsd, amd, WU-FTPD, BIND and sadmind overflows, IIS and TFN2K), the eight incident notes IN-99-01 to IN-99-08 (sscan, Happy99, CIH, the chained RPC exploits, amd, distributed sniffers, trinoo and TFN, and MDAC RDS), the Microsoft bulletins and later CVE records of the year, the Justice Department releases on the defacers, Moonlight Maze in the 2017 research on the HRTest relay and LOKI2, and the Reported accounts of the 1999 defacements. No 1999 source prints an ATT&CK id: every entry is this study's later mapping. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_1999.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
